narration: Hello everyone. Welcome to RepoPilot AI, built by team QuantumSix for Hackathon 2.0. Our tagline is simple: One Prompt. Complete Feature Delivery.
Let us sign in to the platform. The same login works on Windows and Ubuntu, with no separate setup required.
And we land on the main dashboard. Here you can see project count, active tasks, merge requests, and indexing status, everything at one glance.
RepoPilot gives a complete SDLC view, from repository indexing to AI-generated code and GitLab merge requests. Navigation is on the left side.
We also support light and dark mode, which is useful for long coding sessions.
Now let us connect a real GitLab repository. RepoPilot clones the repo, parses all files, and builds a knowledge graph of the codebase.
Indexing runs in the background. Embeddings are stored in Qdrant, and progress is shown live on the screen.
Now we create a live demo task. Task DT-0004 renames the label Sides Preview to Sides Preview 123. We upload it from CSV in one click.
Watch the agents start working. Requirement analysis, repository intelligence, and impact analysis run automatically on our indexed codebase.
Analysis completes with user stories and test cases. We approve it, and the Code Generation Agent takes over the label change.
Here is the generated diff for the rename. Every file change is visible on the Code Diff tab before we approve and ship.
Validation and QA run automatically. Tests execute and a GitLab merge request opens. One prompt, complete feature delivery.
The Reports page gives team-level analytics, task status breakdown, agent activity, and QA summary.
Under Integrations, we connect GitLab and configure OpenAI or Hugging Face as the AI provider. API keys are stored securely.
RepoPilot AI. One Prompt. Complete Feature Delivery. Built by QuantumSix. Thank you for watching.
